senses.en: to grow old; to let food or wine mature
senses.pattern: age well / age quickly / an aging population / age wine in barrels
senses.example: Doctors warn that too much sun can make your skin [[age]] much faster than it normally would.
senses.example_zh: 醫師警告，曬太多太陽會讓皮膚變老的速度比正常情況快得多。
senses.note: 現在分詞 aging／ageing 皆可

senses.en: a particular period of history
senses.pattern: the Stone Age / the digital age / the Middle Ages / the age of exploration
senses.example: In the digital [[age]], news that once took weeks to spread can reach millions within seconds.
senses.example_zh: 在數位時代，過去要花數週才能傳開的消息，幾秒內就能傳到數百萬人眼前。
senses.note: 專有名稱常大寫：the Ice Age

gsat.sentence: Why maps were important during the [[age]] of exploration.
The preference for north arose during the European [[age]] of exploration.

senses.en: a large number of people or things
senses.pattern: an army of volunteers / an army of ants / an army of fans
senses.example: After the flood, an [[army]] of volunteers arrived with shovels to help residents clean their homes.
senses.example_zh: 水災過後，大批志工帶著鏟子前來，幫助居民清理家園。
senses.note: 常用 an army of＋複數名詞

senses.en: the land along the side of a river
senses.pattern: the river bank / on the opposite bank / along the banks of
senses.example: We spread a blanket on the grassy [[bank]] and watched ducks swimming down the river.
senses.example_zh: 我們在長滿青草的河岸上鋪了毯子，看鴨子順著河水游去。

senses.en: a stored supply kept for later use
senses.pattern: a blood bank / a food bank / a seed bank / a data bank
senses.example: The hospital's blood [[bank]] is running low, so doctors are urging healthy adults to donate.
senses.example_zh: 醫院血庫的存量偏低，因此醫師呼籲健康的成年人捐血。

senses.en: to rely on something happening
senses.pattern: bank on sb / bank on doing sth / don't bank on it
senses.example: Don't [[bank]] on good weather for the picnic; bring an umbrella just in case.
senses.example_zh: 別指望野餐那天會有好天氣，還是帶把傘以防萬一。
senses.note: 固定與 on 連用：bank on

gsat.sentence: Then, the tortoise carries the hare and swims to the opposite [[bank]] of the river.
Situated on both [[banks]] of the winding River Vltava, Prague is like one big open-air museum.

senses.en: something good that you are grateful for
senses.pattern: a blessing in disguise / a mixed blessing / count your blessings
senses.example: The heavy rain was a [[blessing]] for farmers whose fields had been dry for months.
senses.example_zh: 對田地乾旱了好幾個月的農民來說，這場大雨真是件幸事。
senses.note: a blessing in disguise＝因禍得福

senses.en: approval of or permission for something
senses.pattern: with sb's blessing / give sth your blessing / have the blessing of
senses.example: With her parents' [[blessing]], Amy left her office job to open a small bakery.
senses.example_zh: 在父母的同意下，艾咪辭去辦公室的工作，開了一家小麵包店。

gsat.sentence: “The [[blessing]] that Morgan has brought is beyond anything that I ever could have imagined and could explain.”

senses.en: used to show the amount of difference
senses.pattern: rise by 10% / win by two points / miss the bus by a minute
senses.example: Our team lost the final [[by]] only one point, which made the defeat even harder to accept.
senses.example_zh: 我們隊在決賽僅以一分之差落敗，這讓失敗更難以接受。

senses.en: according to a rule, standard, or unit
senses.pattern: by law / paid by the hour / judge sb by / sell sth by the kilo
senses.example: Part-time workers at the café are paid [[by]] the hour, so longer shifts mean more money.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡店的工讀生按照時數計薪，所以班排得越長，賺得越多。

gsat.sentence: [[By]] its reputation or the test scores it requires for admission?

senses.en: to publicly support or fight for a cause
senses.pattern: champion a cause / champion the rights of / champion reform
senses.example: Several famous athletes have [[championed]] the campaign to bring free sports lessons to rural schools.
senses.example_zh: 好幾位知名運動員公開擁護這項為偏鄉學校提供免費體育課的活動。

senses.en: a person who fights for a cause or group
senses.pattern: a champion of human rights / a champion of the poor / a champion of equal rights
senses.example: The writer was known as a [[champion]] of the poor and often spoke out against unfair laws.
senses.example_zh: 這位作家以窮人的擁護者聞名，經常挺身反對不公平的法律。
senses.note: 常用 a champion of＋理念／群體

senses.en: a comfortable bus for long journeys
senses.pattern: a coach tour / travel by coach / a coach station / a coach trip
senses.example: We toured Scotland by [[coach]], stopping at old castles and small fishing villages along the way.
senses.example_zh: 我們搭遊覽車遊蘇格蘭，沿途在古堡和小漁村停留。
senses.note: 英式用法；美式多說 bus

senses.en: the cheapest class of seats on a plane or train
senses.pattern: fly coach / a coach seat / a coach ticket / travel in coach
senses.example: To save money, the whole family flew [[coach]] and spent the difference on a nicer hotel.
senses.example_zh: 為了省錢，全家人都搭經濟艙，把省下來的錢拿去住好一點的飯店。

senses.en: to bring or come together in one place
senses.pattern: be concentrated in / concentrate power / concentrate resources on
senses.example: Most of the country's population is [[concentrated]] along the coast, where the land is flat and fertile.
senses.example_zh: 該國大部分人口集中在沿海地區，那裡地勢平坦、土壤肥沃。

senses.en: a substance made stronger by removing water
senses.pattern: orange juice concentrate / tomato concentrate / made from concentrate
senses.example: This apple juice is made from [[concentrate]], so water was added back before it was bottled.
senses.example_zh: 這款蘋果汁是由濃縮液還原製成，所以裝瓶前又把水加了回去。

gsat.sentence: Scientists found that sharp corners are natural weak spots where stress [[concentrates]].
A book town is a rural town in which second-hand and antiquarian bookshops are [[concentrated]].

senses.en: a single book or newspaper among many printed
senses.pattern: a copy of the book / sell a million copies / a signed copy / a free copy
senses.example: The novel sold over two million [[copies]] in its first year and was later made into a film.
senses.example_zh: 這本小說第一年就賣出超過兩百萬本，後來還被改編成電影。

senses.en: written text for an advertisement or a newspaper
senses.pattern: write copy / advertising copy / edit copy
senses.example: She writes advertising [[copy]] for a shoe company, trying to make every sentence short and catchy.
senses.example_zh: 她替一家鞋業公司寫廣告文案，力求每個句子都簡短又吸睛。

gsat.sentence: So, grab a [[copy]] and start learning how you can reduce stress in your life.

senses.en: money a court orders paid for harm caused
senses.pattern: pay damages / claim damages / be awarded damages / sue for damages
senses.example: The singer sued the magazine for [[damages]] after it printed false stories about her family.
senses.example_zh: 該雜誌刊登有關她家人的不實報導後，這名歌手提告，要求對方支付損害賠償金。

senses.en: to make someone worried or upset
senses.pattern: be deeply disturbed by / be disturbed to learn / it disturbs sb that
senses.example: Parents were deeply [[disturbed]] by reports that some students had been bullied online for months.
senses.example_zh: 有報導指出部分學生遭網路霸凌長達數月，這使家長深感不安。
senses.note: 形容詞 disturbing＝令人不安的

senses.en: to change the normal state or position of something
senses.pattern: disturb the balance / disturb sleep patterns / disturb the peace / disturb the soil
senses.example: Please don't [[disturb]] the papers on my desk; I have arranged them in a special order.
senses.example_zh: 請不要弄亂我桌上的文件，我是照特定順序排好的。

gsat.sentence: There never seemed to be enough time to go to church, which [[disturbed]] some friends and relatives.

Furthermore, watching horror movies can [[disturb]] sleep patterns, as the residual fear and anxiety they evoke may keep people awake all night, thus leading to fatigue and irritability the following day.

senses.en: to make pain or a problem less severe
senses.pattern: ease the pain / ease tension / ease traffic congestion / ease sb's worries
senses.example: A cup of warm ginger tea may help [[ease]] a sore throat on cold winter nights.
senses.example_zh: 在寒冷的冬夜，一杯溫熱的薑茶或許有助於減輕喉嚨痛。

senses.en: to move something slowly and carefully
senses.pattern: ease the car into / ease the door open / ease yourself into a chair
senses.example: The driver slowly [[eased]] the huge truck through the narrow gate without touching either side.
senses.example_zh: 司機小心緩慢地把大卡車開過窄門，兩邊都沒有碰到。

gsat.sentence: Research shows that modest amounts of exercise—even just 15 minutes a day—helps [[ease]] depression, enhance self-image, relieve stress, and much more.
The report concludes with an earnest request to international policymakers to distribute financial and other resources to [[ease]] the regional crisis.

senses.en: to use a power, right, or quality
senses.pattern: exercise your right / exercise caution / exercise control / exercise judgment
senses.example: Few students [[exercise]] their right to ask for a second review of their exam papers.
senses.example_zh: 很少學生會行使要求複查考卷的權利。

senses.en: practice activities to train soldiers or emergency workers
senses.pattern: a military exercise / a joint exercise / a training exercise
senses.example: Thousands of soldiers took part in a three-day military [[exercise]] held in the desert.
senses.example_zh: 數千名士兵參加了在沙漠舉行、為期三天的軍事演習。

senses.en: to include as an important part or performer
senses.pattern: feature live music / a film featuring / be featured in / feature sb as
senses.example: This year's science fair will [[feature]] robots designed and built entirely by high school students.
senses.example_zh: 今年的科展將以完全由高中生設計製作的機器人為特色。

senses.en: a special article or program about a subject
senses.pattern: a feature on / a feature article / a feature story / a special feature
senses.example: The magazine ran a ten-page [[feature]] on young farmers who returned to their hometowns.
senses.example_zh: 這本雜誌刊登了一篇十頁的專題報導，介紹返鄉的青年農民。

senses.en: a part of the face, such as the eyes or nose
senses.pattern: facial features / delicate features / sharp features / handsome features
senses.example: The baby has her mother's delicate [[features]], including the same small nose and bright eyes.
senses.example_zh: 這個寶寶遺傳了媽媽細緻的五官，同樣有小巧的鼻子和明亮的眼睛。

gsat.sentence: Open since 1996, the store [[features]] traditional-style home accessories, ranging from cabinets and chairs to picture frames and decorative mirrors.
Typically [[featuring]] zombies and serial killers, horror movies are too frightening to be fun for some people.

senses.en: the lowest part of something
senses.pattern: at the foot of the mountain / the foot of the stairs / the foot of the page / the foot of the bed
senses.example: Please sign your name at the [[foot]] of the page before you hand in the form.
senses.example_zh: 繳交表格前，請在頁面底部簽上你的名字。
senses.note: at the foot of the mountain＝在山腳

senses.en: to pay a bill, especially a large one
senses.pattern: foot the bill / foot the bill for / foot the cost
senses.example: When the old bridge collapsed, taxpayers had to [[foot]] the bill for building a new one.
senses.example_zh: 舊橋倒塌後，興建新橋的費用只得由納稅人支付。
senses.note: 幾乎只用於 foot the bill

senses.en: larger or more than usual or expected
senses.pattern: a generous portion / a generous amount of / a generous helping / generous leg room
senses.example: The restaurant is famous for serving [[generous]] portions, so most customers cannot finish their meals.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳以餐點分量豐盛聞名，所以大多數客人都吃不完。

senses.en: a sudden large increase in prices or amounts
senses.pattern: a price hike / a tax hike / a hike in fares / a rate hike
senses.example: Drivers rushed to fill their tanks the night before the fuel price [[hike]] took effect.
senses.example_zh: 油價大幅上漲生效的前一晚，駕駛人紛紛趕去把油加滿。

senses.en: to raise prices, taxes, or rates suddenly
senses.pattern: hike prices / hike taxes / hike interest rates / hike fees
senses.example: The airline [[hiked]] its ticket prices right before the holidays, angering many travelers.
senses.example_zh: 這家航空公司在假期前夕調漲票價，激怒了許多旅客。

senses.en: extra money paid for borrowing or saving money
senses.pattern: pay interest on a loan / earn interest / interest rates / with interest
senses.example: If you keep your money in this account, you will earn two percent [[interest]] every year.
senses.example_zh: 如果你把錢存在這個帳戶，每年可以賺到百分之二的利息。

senses.en: an advantage or benefit to someone
senses.pattern: in sb's best interest / protect your interests / the public interest / a conflict of interest
senses.example: It is in your own [[interest]] to read the contract carefully before you sign it.
senses.example_zh: 簽約前仔細閱讀合約內容，才符合你自身的利益。
senses.note: in the interest of＝為了…的利益

gsat.sentence: People in this community tend to identify with the group they belong to, and often put group [[interests]] before personal ones.
It is believed that this would be to the best [[interest]] of all people, especially teens who might be tempted to start smoking.

senses.en: to put down a foundation, cable, or carpet
senses.pattern: lay the foundation for / lay a cable / lay a carpet / lay the groundwork
senses.example: Reading widely in childhood [[lays]] a solid foundation for clear writing later in life.
senses.example_zh: 童年時期廣泛閱讀，能為日後清晰的寫作能力奠定扎實的基礎。
senses.note: lay 也是 lie（躺）的過去式

senses.en: not trained in a particular subject or profession
senses.pattern: a lay person / a lay audience / the lay public / lay readers
senses.example: The doctor explained the surgery in simple words that any [[lay]] person could easily understand.
senses.example_zh: 醫師用淺顯的話解釋這項手術，任何外行的人都能輕易聽懂。

gsat.sentence: Construction began when the first cornerstone was [[laid]] in October of 1792.

senses.en: (of colors or clothes) too bright and showy
senses.pattern: a loud shirt / loud colors / a loud tie / a loud pattern
senses.example: The living room walls were painted in such [[loud]] colors that guests found it hard to relax.
senses.example_zh: 客廳的牆壁漆成十分俗豔的顏色，客人都覺得很難放鬆。

senses.en: a device that measures the amount of something used
senses.pattern: a parking meter / a water meter / an electricity meter / read the meter
senses.example: A worker comes every two months to read the gas [[meter]] outside our kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 每兩個月會有人員來抄我們廚房外的瓦斯表。
senses.note: 計程車的計費表也叫 meter

senses.en: the rhythmic pattern of a poem
senses.pattern: poetic meter / rhyme and meter / a regular meter
senses.example: Our teacher asked us to clap along to feel the [[meter]] of the poem as she read.
senses.example_zh: 老師朗讀時要我們跟著拍手，感受這首詩的格律。

senses.en: (of a plant or animal) originally from a place
senses.pattern: be native to / native plants / native species / a native bird
senses.example: These wild lilies are [[native]] to Taiwan and can be found from the seashore to the high mountains.
senses.example_zh: 這種野百合原產於臺灣，從海邊到高山都能見到。

senses.en: a person born in a particular place
senses.pattern: a native of Tainan / a native of the island / speak like a native
senses.example: Although the chef is a [[native]] of Italy, he has run a noodle shop in Tainan for years.
senses.example_zh: 這位主廚雖然是土生土長的義大利人，卻已在臺南開麵店多年。
senses.note: a native of＋地方＝在該地出生的人

gsat.sentence: The pineapple, long a symbol of Hawaii, was not a [[native]] plant.
[[Natives]] planted the fruit across South and Central America and in the Caribbean region, where Christopher Columbus first found it.

senses.en: about a particular subject
senses.pattern: a book on / a lecture on / advice on / a report on
senses.example: The library has just bought several new books [[on]] space travel for curious young readers.
senses.example_zh: 圖書館剛買了幾本關於太空旅行的新書，給充滿好奇心的小讀者看。
senses.note: 比 about 正式，多指專門主題

senses.en: immediately after something happens
senses.pattern: on arrival / on hearing the news / on request / on sb's return
senses.example: [[On]] hearing the fire alarm, the students lined up and walked calmly to the playground.
senses.example_zh: 一聽到火災警報，學生們就排好隊，鎮定地走到操場。

gsat.sentence: Here are some tips [[on]] choosing an ideal one from a number of colleges.
Dr. Chu’s speech [[on]] the new energy source attracted great attention from the audience at the conference.

senses.en: to criticize a film, book, or play severely
senses.pattern: be panned by critics / pan a film / be widely panned
senses.example: The film was [[panned]] by critics for its weak story, but it still attracted huge audiences.
senses.example_zh: 這部電影因劇情薄弱遭影評人嚴厲批評，卻仍吸引了大批觀眾。

senses.en: (of a camera) to move slowly across a scene
senses.pattern: the camera pans across / pan to the left / pan over the crowd
senses.example: The camera slowly [[pans]] across the empty classroom before stopping at a single open window.
senses.example_zh: 鏡頭緩緩橫搖，拍攝空無一人的教室，最後停在唯一一扇開著的窗戶上。

senses.en: an article in a newspaper or magazine
senses.pattern: a piece on / write a piece for / an opinion piece / a short piece
senses.example: She wrote a thoughtful [[piece]] for the school newspaper about why teenagers need more sleep.
senses.example_zh: 她替校刊寫了一篇發人深省的文章，談青少年為何需要更多睡眠。

senses.en: a single work of art or music
senses.pattern: a piece of music / a piano piece / a piece by Mozart / perform a piece
senses.example: For the contest, each student must perform one classical [[piece]] chosen by the judges.
senses.example_zh: 比賽時，每位學生都必須演奏一首由評審指定的古典作品。

gsat.sentence: Now with the children performing the [[pieces]], parents are beginning to ask, ‘Why do we not know how to sing these ballads?’

senses.en: a job, or the place where someone is on duty
senses.pattern: take up a post / a teaching post / hold a post / leave your post
senses.example: After ten years as a nurse, she took up a new [[post]] as head of the clinic.
senses.example_zh: 當了十年護理師後，她接下診所主任這個新職位。

senses.en: to send someone to work somewhere for a time
senses.pattern: be posted to / be posted abroad / be posted overseas
senses.example: Her father, an engineer, was [[posted]] to Vietnam for three years to manage a new factory.
senses.example_zh: 她的父親是工程師，被派駐越南三年，負責管理一座新工廠。
senses.note: 多用被動 be posted to＋地點

senses.en: a strong upright pole fixed in the ground
senses.pattern: a fence post / a wooden post / a goal post / a lamp post
senses.example: He tied his horse to a wooden [[post]] in front of the store and went inside.
senses.example_zh: 他把馬拴在店門前的一根木樁上，然後走了進去。

gsat.sentence: Totem poles in North America are poles or [[posts]] carved with symbols or figures by Aboriginal peoples of the Northwest Coast.

senses.en: signs that someone or something will be successful
senses.pattern: show promise / hold promise / full of promise / a writer of great promise
senses.example: Early tests suggest that the new vaccine holds real [[promise]], but more research is still needed.
senses.example_zh: 初期試驗顯示這款新疫苗很有潛力，但仍需更多研究。

senses.en: to show signs that something is likely to happen
senses.pattern: promise to be / promise rain / promise a good harvest
senses.example: With three former champions competing, tonight's final [[promises]] to be an exciting match.
senses.example_zh: 有三位前冠軍參賽，今晚的決賽可望成為一場精采的比賽。
senses.note: 常用 promise to be＋形容詞／名詞

senses.en: (of a sign or text) to have certain words
senses.pattern: the sign reads / the note read / the headline reads
senses.example: A small sign on the gate [[read]] "Beware of the dog," so we waited outside.
senses.example_zh: 大門上有個小牌子寫著「內有惡犬」，所以我們在外面等。
senses.note: 主詞是文字、告示，不是人

senses.en: (of an instrument) to show a particular measurement
senses.pattern: the thermometer reads / the meter reads / the scale reads / the clock read
senses.example: When the thermometer [[reads]] above thirty-eight degrees, the school cancels all outdoor activities.
senses.example_zh: 溫度計顯示超過三十八度時，學校會取消所有戶外活動。

senses.en: to interpret something in a particular way
senses.pattern: read sb's mind / read sb's face / read the situation / read sth as
senses.example: I [[read]] her long silence as a sign that she did not agree with our plan.
senses.example_zh: 我把她長時間的沉默解讀為不贊同我們計畫的表示。

senses.en: to use something bad because nothing else works
senses.pattern: resort to violence / resort to lying / resort to force / resort to doing sth
senses.example: Even when you are angry, you should never [[resort]] to violence to settle an argument.
senses.example_zh: 即使在生氣的時候，也絕不該訴諸暴力來解決爭執。
senses.note: resort to＋名詞／V-ing，to 是介系詞

senses.en: a course of action used when others fail
senses.pattern: as a last resort / a measure of last resort / the only resort
senses.example: Surgery should be used only as a last [[resort]], after rest and medicine have both failed.
senses.example_zh: 只有在休息和藥物都無效之後，才應把手術當作最後的手段。
senses.note: as a last resort＝萬不得已時

gsat.sentence: Without a shared language, they often [[resort]] to smiling to get along with others.
Foggers, or bug bombs, should really be a measure of last [[resort]].

senses.en: to try a small amount of food or an activity
senses.pattern: sample local food / sample the wine / sample a dish / sample the nightlife
senses.example: Visitors to the night market can [[sample]] dozens of local snacks without spending much money.
senses.example_zh: 逛夜市的遊客不用花太多錢，就能品嚐數十種在地小吃。

senses.en: to question or test part of a group
senses.pattern: sample 500 students / be randomly sampled / of those sampled
senses.example: The researchers [[sampled]] two thousand teenagers across the country to learn about their sleeping habits.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員對全國兩千名青少年進行抽樣調查，以了解他們的睡眠習慣。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to move or react suddenly
senses.pattern: send prices soaring / send sb into a panic / send sb flying / send sb to sleep
senses.example: The long drought [[sent]] vegetable prices soaring, and many families began growing their own greens.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱使菜價突然飆漲，許多家庭開始自己種菜。

senses.en: typical of and closely associated with someone
senses.pattern: a signature dish / a signature style / a signature song / a signature move
senses.example: The restaurant's [[signature]] dish is a spicy beef noodle soup that has been served since 1960.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳的招牌菜是從 1960 年賣到現在的麻辣牛肉麵。

senses.en: a distinctive quality that identifies something
senses.pattern: the signature of / a chemical signature / a clear signature of
senses.example: Bright colors and bold lines are the [[signature]] of this painter's early work.
senses.example_zh: 鮮豔的色彩和大膽的線條是這位畫家早期作品的特徵。

senses.en: approximately, used before a number
senses.pattern: some 200 people / some fifty years ago / some thirty miles away
senses.example: [[Some]] three hundred runners finished the mountain race despite the heavy rain and strong wind.
senses.example_zh: 儘管風大雨大，仍有大約三百名跑者完成了這場山徑賽。

senses.en: used for an unknown or unnamed person or thing
senses.pattern: for some reason / some day / some kind of / in some way
senses.example: For [[some]] reason, the printer stopped working just before I had to hand in my report.
senses.example_zh: 基於某個原因，印表機偏偏在我要交報告前壞掉了。

gsat.sentence: For those who speak into the wind phone, hope is always there: They believe that their messages will—through [[some]] unknown way—reach the deceased.

senses.en: to play, or to have someone as, the main performer
senses.pattern: star in a film / a film starring / star as / star alongside
senses.example: She [[starred]] in a popular TV drama at sixteen and became famous almost overnight.
senses.example_zh: 她十六歲時主演一部熱門電視劇，幾乎一夜成名。
senses.note: star in＋作品；a film starring＋演員

senses.en: a series of similar things or events
senses.pattern: a string of / a string of hits / a string of accidents / a string of islands
senses.example: After a [[string]] of losses, the coach decided to change the team's training schedule completely.
senses.example_zh: 在一連串的敗仗之後，教練決定徹底改變球隊的訓練時程。

senses.en: special conditions attached to an offer or agreement
senses.pattern: no strings attached / with strings attached / come with strings
senses.example: The company offered free laptops to the school with no [[strings]] attached, which surprised everyone.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司免費提供筆電給學校，而且沒有任何附帶條件，讓大家都很驚訝。

senses.en: a noticeable change in opinion or mood
senses.pattern: mood swings / a swing in public opinion / a sharp swing / a swing toward
senses.example: Teenagers often experience sudden mood [[swings]] that even they themselves cannot explain.
senses.example_zh: 青少年常會出現突如其來的情緒波動，連他們自己也無法解釋。

senses.en: to change, or make something change, quickly
senses.pattern: swing from A to B / swing in sb's favor / swing the vote / swing the decision
senses.example: Public opinion can [[swing]] quickly once people see how a new policy affects their daily lives.
senses.example_zh: 一旦民眾看到新政策如何影響日常生活，輿論可能很快就會轉向。

senses.en: to measure how long something takes
senses.pattern: time a race / time sb / time how long / time yourself
senses.example: The coach [[timed]] each swimmer with a stopwatch and wrote the results on a whiteboard.
senses.example_zh: 教練用碼錶替每位泳者計時，並把成績寫在白板上。

senses.en: to arrange for something to happen at a particular moment
senses.pattern: be timed to coincide with / time sth well / badly timed / perfectly timed
senses.example: The concert was [[timed]] to end just before the last train left the station.
senses.example_zh: 音樂會的時間特意安排在末班車離站前結束。

senses.en: a period in history or in someone's life
senses.pattern: in ancient times / in modern times / hard times / keep up with the times
senses.example: In ancient [[times]], salt was so valuable that soldiers were sometimes paid with it.
senses.example_zh: 在古代，鹽非常珍貴，士兵的薪餉有時就是用鹽支付的。

gsat.sentence: Why is the spiral staircase popular in modern [[times]]?
In Victorian [[times]], cast iron spiral staircases were popular for public buildings and homes for the rich.

senses.en: an arrangement in which money is managed for someone
senses.pattern: a trust fund / set up a trust / hold sth in trust / a charitable trust
senses.example: Her grandparents set up a [[trust]] to pay for her college education before she was born.
senses.example_zh: 她還沒出生，祖父母就設立了信託，用來支付她的大學學費。

senses.en: to give someone something important to look after
senses.pattern: trust sb with sth / trust sb with a secret / be trusted with
senses.example: I would never [[trust]] my little brother with my phone; he drops everything he touches.
senses.example_zh: 我絕不會把手機託付給我弟弟，他拿什麼就摔什麼。
senses.note: 句型 trust A with B

gsat.sentence: For instance, he was [[trusted]] with many secrets in my family and our community.

senses.en: (of eyes or mouth) to fill with liquid
senses.pattern: make your eyes water / make your mouth water / eyes watering from smoke
senses.example: The smell of fried chicken from the kitchen made my mouth [[water]] before dinner was ready.
senses.example_zh: 廚房飄來的炸雞香味，讓我在晚餐還沒好之前就流口水了。

senses.en: an area of sea or lake, often a country's
senses.pattern: coastal waters / in international waters / the waters off the coast / shallow waters
senses.example: Fishing boats are not allowed to enter these protected [[waters]] during the breeding season.
senses.example_zh: 繁殖季期間，漁船不得進入這片受保護的水域。

gsat.sentence: Situated off the coast of Tanzania and washed by the warm, clean [[waters]] of the Indian Ocean, Zanzibar is a tropical archipelago comprised of several scattered islands.
From Turkey, she boarded a small boat that held 20 people and set sail into the deep [[waters]] of the Aegean Sea.

senses.en: used with "have yet to" for something not done
senses.pattern: have yet to do / be yet to do / have yet to be decided
senses.example: The city has [[yet]] to announce when the new swimming pool will open to the public.
senses.example_zh: 市府尚未宣布新游泳池何時對外開放。
senses.note: have yet to V＝還沒…（不加 not）

senses.en: but; in spite of that
senses.pattern: simple yet effective / and yet / strange yet true
senses.example: The instructions looked simple, [[yet]] nobody in the class could finish the model in time.
senses.example_zh: 說明看起來很簡單，然而班上沒有人能及時完成模型。

senses.en: used to emphasize an increase or repetition
senses.pattern: yet another / yet again / yet more / worse yet
senses.example: The train was delayed [[yet]] again this morning, so half the class arrived late.
senses.example_zh: 今天早上火車又誤點了，所以班上有一半的人遲到。

gsat.sentence: But the culinary art of dim sum had [[yet]] to develop, for it was considered inappropriate to pair tea with food.
[[Yet]] listening well is a rare talent that everyone should treasure.

quiz.stem: Throughout her career, the scientist ______ the rights of women in research, speaking at conferences and urging universities to hire more female professors.
quiz.explain_zh: champion＝擁護、捍衛。這位科學家一生為女性研究人員的權益發聲。

quiz.stem: Many commuters complained about the sudden ______ in train fares, which made their daily trips to work nearly twenty percent more expensive.
quiz.explain_zh: hike＝大幅上漲。火車票價突然調漲，通勤族上班的車資貴了近兩成。

quiz.stem: When the school trip was canceled because of the typhoon, the travel agency agreed to ______ the bill for the hotel rooms that had already been booked.
quiz.explain_zh: foot＝支付（帳單）。旅行社同意負擔已訂飯店房間的費用。

quiz.stem: Mr. Wang usually wears plain gray suits, so his coworkers were shocked when he showed up in a ______ purple-and-orange jacket that almost hurt their eyes.
quiz.explain_zh: loud＝（顏色）俗豔的。平常穿素色西裝的王先生竟穿了刺眼的花俏外套。

quiz.stem: After the factory was found guilty of polluting the river, the court ordered it to pay two million dollars in ______ to nearby farmers.
quiz.explain_zh: damages＝損害賠償金。法院判工廠賠償附近農民兩百萬元。

quiz.stem: According to the latest report, the number of local students studying abroad has dropped ______ fifteen percent over the past two years.
quiz.explain_zh: by＝相差、以…的幅度。出國留學的學生人數兩年內減少了百分之十五。

quiz.stem: Unable to find new jobs after the factory closed, some workers had to ______ to borrowing money from relatives just to pay their rent.
quiz.explain_zh: resort＝不得已採取（resort to）。失業工人只好向親戚借錢付房租。

quiz.stem: The kiwi, a flightless bird ______ to New Zealand, is now threatened by cats, dogs, and other animals that were brought to the islands by settlers.
quiz.explain_zh: native＝原產於…的。奇異鳥原產於紐西蘭，如今受外來動物威脅。

quiz.stem: Although she is only fifteen, the young pianist has shown great ______, and her teachers believe she will perform on the world stage one day.
quiz.explain_zh: promise＝前途、潛力。這位年輕鋼琴家很有潛力，老師相信她會登上世界舞台。

quiz.stem: Researchers have studied the rare disease for decades, but they have ______ to find a treatment that works for every patient.
quiz.explain_zh: yet＝尚未（have yet to）。研究人員至今還沒找到對所有病人都有效的療法。
